angles: LogRocket's 2026 power rankings shakeup: Windsurf dethroned Cursor for #1 — what changed and what it signals about developer preferences
The new Big Three: Cursor (established market leader, $2B ARR), Claude Code (fastest-growing, 91% CSAT), Windsurf/Antigravity (upstarts shaking up rankings)
Multi-tool reality: 70% of developers use 2-4 tools — rankings should reflect tool stacks, not single-tool dominance
The trust-productivity paradox: 90% adoption but only 29% trust, 19% measured slowdown yet 20% perceived speedup — what developers say vs what data shows
From autocomplete to agents: session length grew 4 min→23 min, multi-file edits up from 34%→78% — the agentic shift is real
Enterprise vs. indie developer tool preferences: Copilot dominates large orgs (40-56%), startups favor Claude Code (75%) and Cursor (42%)
The security reckoning: 45% of AI code has known flaws, 10,000+ security findings/month — security tools becoming the next power ranking category
Market consolidation ahead: Windsurf acquired by Cognition, Antigravity's security issues, Cursor's $29B valuation — winner(s) still uncertain
How the Pragmatic Engineer survey (15K developers) and JetBrains AI Pulse are becoming the definitive power ranking methodologies
